svg.title: Late divisome proteins at midcell
svg.desc: Gram-negative envelope section at the division site: an FtsZ filament held by FtsA and ZipA under the inner membrane, with recruited late proteins FtsQLB, FtsW-FtsI and FtsN spanning to the murein.
